face.name: 元素混合
face.text: 随机将法力值消耗为（1），（2）和（3）的元素牌各一张置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 元素混音技术问世之后，艾泽拉斯进入了合成乐的时代。

face.name: Synthesize
face.text: Add a random 1, 2, and 3-Cost Elemental to your hand.
face.flavorText: After the invention of elemental audio processing, Azeroth went through a major synth phase.

face.name: 抱团
face.text: 用随机纳迦填满你的面板。
face.flavorText: 法术，纳迦，纳迦，纳迦，纳迦，纳迦，纳迦，纳迦……

face.name: Huddle Up
face.text: Fill your board with random Naga.
face.flavorText: Spell, Naga, Naga, Naga, Naga, Naga, Naga, Naga...

face.name: 超级新星
face.text: 用随机火焰法术牌填满你的手牌。这些法术牌的法力值消耗为（1）点。
face.flavorText: 喜欢热天的朋友一定会说这种天相棒极了。

face.name: Supernova
face.text: Fill your hand with random Fire spells. They cost (1).
face.flavorText: People who enjoy the heat will say this looks like perfect weather.

face.name: 火焰之地传送门
face.text: 造成 6点伤害。随机召唤一个法力值消耗为（6）的随从。
face.flavorText: 火焰之地是由泰坦所铸造的一个熔火领域，用来关押拉格纳罗斯和他那群无法无天的爪牙。

face.name: Firelands Portal
face.text: Deal 6 damage. Summon a random 6-Cost minion.
face.flavorText: Come to beautiful Firelands! Where it's "Way nicer than the Abyssal Maw!"

face.name: 埃匹希斯冲击
face.text: 造成 5点伤害。如果你的牌库中没有随从牌，随机召唤一个法力值消耗为（5）的随从。
face.flavorText: 落单的法师照样可以冲你们一群！

face.name: Apexis Blast
face.text: Deal 5 damage. If your deck has no minions, summon a random 5-Cost minion.
face.flavorText: Lonely mages can still have a blast!

face.name: 夕阳漫射
face.text: 造成 10点伤害，随机分配到所有敌人身上。随机召唤一个法力值消耗为（10）的随从。
face.flavorText: 当夕阳光线刚刚好的时候，你就可以拿出自拍杆狠狠地拍一通了。

face.name: Sunset Volley
face.text: Deal 10 damage randomly split among all enemies. Summon a random 10-Cost minion.
face.flavorText: When the light is just right during Golden Hour, that is when you take out the selfie stick and start casting.

face.name: 魔法新发现
face.text: 发现一张你在本局对战中尚未施放过的派系的法术牌（任意职业）。
face.flavorText: 书读百遍，法术自现！

face.name: Discovery of Magic
face.text: Discover a spell from a spell school you haven't cast this game (from any class).
face.flavorText: It's in a book, just take a look!

face.name: 混乱化形
face.text: 造成 6点伤害。随机召唤一个法力值消耗为（6）的随从。摧毁你牌库底的6张牌。
face.flavorText: 原来是它把大家染绿了！

face.name: Chaos Creation
face.text: Deal 6 damage. Summon a random 6-Cost minion. Destroy the bottom 6 cards of your deck.
face.flavorText: So THIS is who's been Greening everything!

face.name: 寻物解谜
face.text: 发现一张奥秘牌，将其法力值消耗变为（1）点。
face.flavorText: 图中共有99个侏儒，你能全部找出来吗？

face.name: Hidden Objects
face.text: Discover a Secret. Set its Cost to (1).
face.flavorText: There are 99 gnomes in this picture. Can YOU find them all?

face.name: 元素唤醒
face.text: 在本回合中，你使用的下一张元素牌的法力值消耗减少（2）点。
face.flavorText: 诀窍就是用打火机油。

face.name: Elemental Evocation
face.text: The next Elemental you play this turn costs (2) less.
face.flavorText: It's just lighter fluid.

face.name: 灼烧
face.text: 对一个随从造成 4点伤害。如果你在上个回合使用过元素牌，则法力值消耗变为（1）点。
face.flavorText: 你就像那冬天里的一把火。

face.name: Scorch
face.text: Deal 4 damage to a minion. Costs (1) if you played an Elemental last turn.
face.flavorText: The hoof. The hoof. The hoof is on fire.

face.name: 老旧的火把
face.text: 造成 3点伤害。将一张可造成6点伤害的“炽烈的火把”洗入你的牌库。
face.flavorText: 探险者经常需要在黑暗潮湿的环境下进行考古工作，因此火把成了必不可少的工具之一。

face.name: Forgotten Torch
face.text: Deal 3 damage. Shuffle a 'Roaring Torch' into your deck that deals 6 damage.
face.flavorText: Why does a forgotten torch turn into a roaring torch with no provocation? It's one of life's many mysteries.

face.name: 冰冷案例
face.text: 召唤两个2/2的不稳定的骷髅。获得4点护甲值。
face.flavorText: 你看，骷髅就该藏在衣橱里，不能冷藏。

face.name: Cold Case
face.text: Summon two 2/2 Volatile Skeletons. Gain 4 Armor.
face.flavorText: And that's why you keep your skeletons in your closet instead of your freezer.

face.name: 堆塑雪人
face.text: 召唤一个3/3的可以冻结攻击目标的雪人。将一张堆塑雪怪置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 让雪球滚起来，这就是最酷的法术牌。

face.name: Build a Snowman
face.text: Summon a 3/3 Snowman that Freezes. Add "Build a Snowbrute" to your hand.
face.flavorText: This is the coolest spell once you get it rolling.

face.name: 元素伙伴
face.text: 随机召唤一个元素伙伴。
face.flavorText: 总是出霍法。

face.flavorText: Always Hiffar.

uncertainties: All15 spells belong to the complete179 past Mage reference. Nine new noncollectible children and collectible REV_845 are actual named dependencies, not new Standard deck roots. The original full inventories and weighting are retained.

Synthesize independently generates printed-cost1/2/3 Elemental minions; WORK_012 fills actual remaining board capacity with Naga. These generic unqualified random tribes and Supernova Fire spells use the existing complete ordinary all-class domain; exact CN generation exceptions remain unconfirmed.

Supernova captures free hand slots once and permanently assigns cost1 to the generated Fire spells through the ordinary local cost attachment. Intervening hand changes do not refill beyond the original accepted count; exact pricing layer/notification boundaries remain existing local policy.

Firelands Portal uses the current complete raw6-damage/6-cost summon face, not its older5-damage/5-cost memory. Apexis Blast freezes initial no-minion-deck condition before damage reactions. Sunset Volley captures10 split-damage budget then ordinary10-cost summon.

Chaos Creation damages6, summons from the complete6-cost domain, then captures the current bottom6 original deck references only at the final stage and delegates one DestroyDeckBatch. Exact inter-stage and game-terminal rules retain existing shared local timing.

Discovery of Magic excludes schools from this player successful completed cast history across origins; untyped spells are ineligible, and all schools already used yields an explicit empty body without a default unfiltered query. Attempt/countered and exact CN history windows remain uncalibrated.

Cost filters and normal discovery classes use existing shared APIs: Spot the Difference discovers a current-class Secret at permanent cost1, Elemental Evocation is a one-use current-turn Elemental minion discount, and Scorch uses the previous completed owner-turn Elemental policy.

Build a Snowman uses original3/6/9 mana and3/3,6/6,9/9 named children. Their damage-freeze TriggerSpec reuses the exact existing Water Elemental behavior; no copied freeze/death executor or printed-identity substitution.

Elemental Companion keeps its exact three physical candidate faces: DEEP_002t friendly spell-cost aura-1, DEEP_002t2 spell damage2, DEEP_002t3 Elusive. The original DEEP_002te remains evidence in the fixed complete raw catalog; its display enchantment is represented by the ordinary aura rather than an executable card.
